source_commit_role: Last behavior-changing commit. WP-GATE-0.3 adds only the preregistration and its validator.
execution_commit_policy: The later runner commit must be frozen and recorded before calibration. It may implement only the listed prerequisites; any change to scorer, generator, policy, utility, statistics, or split semantics requires a new versioned instance.

scope.treatment: E_FULL_GEOMETRY with a fixed support-margin gate
scope.control: E_FULL_GEOMETRY with the override gate disabled
out_of_scope: B_INCOHERENT, C_THETA_ZERO, and D_U1_PHASE score implementations
other path horizons or path geometries
domains outside the four frozen families

environment.numeric_determinism_rule: Every replicate records its generator, outcome, policy, and branch random-stream seeds. Any environment deviation is a new instance.

domain_manifest.generator_semantics: The four E0-G1-v1 generators at source_commit, copied into a calibration-specific namespace whose validator accepts only the split seeds below.
domain_manifest.family_scale_weighting: Each of 12 family-scale cells has equal weight.
domain_manifest.reason: This instance estimates the value of E_FULL_GEOMETRY gate decisions in the declared domain population; it does not test a phase-attribution claim.

exploration.role: Historical G1-v1 development evidence only; may motivate candidates but may not select or confirm them.

protected_holdout.access_condition: Open only after the frozen selected policy passes verification without retuning.

paired_decision_stage.source_trajectory: At every common-guard-eligible disagreement on each candidate's own closed-loop trajectory, before the parent action is applied.
paired_decision_stage.post_branch_rollout_policy: The disabled-gate E_FULL_GEOMETRY control from the branched state.
paired_decision_stage.rollout_horizon: Until terminal state or the original episode's remaining 4 * actual_node_count interaction budget is exhausted.
paired_decision_stage.rollout_budget: Equal remaining interaction budget in both branches.
paired_decision_stage.branch_utility: success_adjusted_efficiency in [0,1], using the G1-v1 oracle-cost definition
paired_decision_stage.candidate_risk_attribution: For each threshold, evaluate harm only on recorded disagreements whose support margin meets that threshold and that the candidate would therefore override.

closed_loop_stage.primary_utility: Mean success_adjusted_efficiency over the 20 evaluation episodes.
closed_loop_stage.infrastructure_failure: Invalid cell; fix infrastructure and rerun the entire candidate-family-scale cell with identical seeds while retaining the failed artifact.

minimum_activation_support.applies_to: Each non-disabled candidate on calibration and again to the selected policy on verification.

statistics.proportion_interval: The same replicate-cluster bootstrap over replicate-level harmful and severe-harm counts; decisions are not treated as independent.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni at family-wise alpha 0.05 across every non-disabled candidate and every eligibility constraint within a split.

eligible_if: all risk-budget constraints pass after multiplicity correction
selection_rule.optimization: Largest pooled equal-cell-weight mean primary effect among eligible non-disabled candidates.
selection_rule.tie_breaker: Among eligible candidates within 0.005 primary-effect units of the best point estimate, choose the largest min_support_margin; remaining exact ties sort by policy_id.

verification_rule.failure_action: Select gate_disabled and do not open protected_holdout.
verification_rule.pass_action: Freeze verification artifact and permit one protected_holdout execution.

implementation_prerequisites: Implement a calibration-specific domain namespace without weakening the E0-G1-v1 holdout guard.
Implement complete deterministic state snapshots and paired branch rollouts.
Implement policy-parameterized E_FULL_GEOMETRY without changing E0-G1-v1.
Implement split-aware artifact schemas, checksums, and infrastructure-failure retention.
Implement the frozen clustered statistics and selection report.
Add a dry-run plan that proves counts and seed separation before execution.
forbidden_before_execution: Changing candidates after reading any calibration outcome.
Instantiating verification or protected-holdout domains during runner development.
Changing a framework default from this preregistration alone.
